header_desc: Tips for keyboard shortcuts, floating bubble navigation, and feedback submission.
hover_desc: Hover over any bubble for 100ms to open chat without clicking. Moving mouse away for 1s smoothly auto-closes it.
shortcut_desc: Press this shortcut anytime while working in Windows to show or hide all chat bubbles.
optimize_title: Resource Tip: Close Dashboard to Background
banner_title: Free RAM & CPU when not managing settings
banner_desc: After enabling chat bubbles, you should click [X] to close Dashboard. The dashboard interface will be completely freed from memory, while ultra-lightweight Win32 bubbles stay connected 24/7.
step1_desc: Click [X] at the top right. The app does not quit; it automatically minimizes to the System Tray.
step2_desc: When needing settings, double-click the app icon in the Windows Taskbar (near the clock) to reopen.
step3_desc: Right-click the tray icon to quickly toggle individual bubbles, hide all when focusing, or select 'Exit Application'.
tray_tip: Tip: If you don't see the tray icon, click the ^ (Show hidden icons) arrow on the Windows taskbar.
item1_desc: Each account runs in an isolated WebView2 profile. No shared cookies or interfering sessions.
item2_desc: The system automatically assigns distinct theme colors so you never mix up accounts.
item3_desc: Point your cursor directly at a bubble or click Open Chat (Connections page) to summon its chat window immediately.
settings_hint: You can change bubble sizes or customize global shortcuts in Settings.
feedback_desc: Encountered a display glitch or want to suggest new platforms (Zalo, Telegram, Discord)? Send us a note:
feedback_placeholder: Enter your feedback, suggestions or bug report...
feedback_thanks: Thank you! Your feedback has been recorded.
